replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
Ok, first of all I don't have ALL of the evidence because we were in a call but I have an extremely good chunk. I'll set the scene first of all.

First of all I saw Cuish's application on the forums for HOME, and I asked him in private msgs "Are you serious about joining HOME?". 
https://gyazo.com/39c5eaf42384f5200a667a1bebf1a3d1
Next he went on about why he wanted to join HOME and leave Celestial. He then asked me "or could I join xenarch?"
https://gyazo.com/985d5dc2719c1b65b8b9200a07df00a1
At first I didn't believe him so he started persuading me sort of.
I finally thought to myself maybe he might actually want to join because he is a staff member and probably wouldn't fake it. I then called him and we spoke for about 10 minutes. I said to him I will invite him but he told me "I can't access the website right now"
https://gyazo.com/337b11d9e47d2453703569ed95471b8f
Now this is where I thought he was bullshitting because I could get onto the website fine. I checked the website to see if he was online and yes he was, he then sent me an image of an error 404 image STRAIGHT OFF GOOGLE (LOL)
https://gyazo.com/eadb415950de4425e0f4a0b3fc550d67
NOW THISSSSS is where I thought he was bullshitting. I still couldn't believe him he wanted to join because he kept telling me he did and admitted the image being fake. 
https://gyazo.com/d82513968b6956e115d41e5c3ffa1fc3
He admitted the image being fake and sent me one of the Avicus website loading and he said "it just keeps loading"
https://gyazo.com/9d1f471ce4a3f0cf581cf41c0a7489dc
He then starting going on an on and we were arguing because I kept denying him. He then left Celestial on the forums and showed me an image and I checked for myself and he actually did leave the team. I just had a thought he POSSIBLY could be serious. 
https://gyazo.com/3c73e790c8443848ecdf236a939f0443
I then invited him and went to bed.
Next morning I see this...
https://gyazo.com/de27819dc9e8f322f55ec685b6ca1732
He told me it was a prank so obviously knowing me I was gonna blow up because I was pissed. Not saying this was right, but I was just pissed. He then tried being a smartass about it because I got his team name wrong and thats pretty much the end.
Now back to this image in my original post!
https://gyazo.com/3fc35969f0553a1fef0552d73e96b1d4
https://gyazo.com/2970c24f340f2c40faef7491a3fefb38
And yes he was right, no shit I was gonna report it.

THE END.
